summary_1line: Gods obtain amrita through Vishnu’s enchantress ruse; Rahu is beheaded after sneaking a sip, sparking eclipses and a battle between gods and Asuras.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vishnu as a radiant enchantress distributes the nectar while the armored Asuras gaze at her spellbound.
Narayana’s discus slices off Rahu’s head as he secretly drinks the nectar among the gods.
The severed head of Rahu rises roaring toward the sky while his colossal headless body crashes to the trembling earth.
